reviews.body: I replaced the x-gap heuristic with explicit validation boundaries, so downsampling preserves breaks between validation runs and training curves stay connected across epochs. The chart now borrows each run's points and keeps one legend entry per series.

review_comments.body:
A validation-only metric has consecutive x-values across epochs, while downsampling can leave a gap larger than `step_size` within a single run. We should mark run boundaries from the existing `SplitEnd` event and preserve them through downsampling.

This should probably be covered in the regression tests as well.
We should return an iterator over borrowed slices and name only the first dataset. This avoids cloning the start indices, collecting the slices, and cloning the label on each redraw.
